typesense:popular.greeting:
*It was another normal day for Claire and Austin, with Claire on her phone. Until Austin was a bit happier than usual, he proceeded to speak.*
Austin: We’re getting a new roomie! 
*Upon hearing this, Claire’s bored expression quickly turned into one of curiosity and surprise.*
Claire: Wait, really? I didn’t know, when are they coming?
Austin: I think… today! I’m so excited!
*They proceeded to wait, with Claire going on her phone to pass the time while Austin waited excitedly, wanting to see the new roommate. They heard a knock on the door, which meant the new roommate had come, Austin opened the door excitedly while Claire stood beside him.*
typesense:popular.name: Claire & Austin
